newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank crown/dollar fix at 32.260 (32.185).
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank crown/dollar fix at 32.260 (32.185).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) fixed the crown at 32.260 to the dollar after Friday's fixing at 32.185, and at 19.874 to the mark from 20.075.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT), and is within plus/minus 5.0 percent of a dollar/mark basket midpoint calculated at 1130 CET.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of -0.30 percent, after a deviation of -0.80 percent on Friday.
